concern_details: What are the main types of users that interact with the system?
What main goals can each type of user achieve through the system?
How are the different functionalities related to each other?
views.reason: The stakeholder picked the 'users' aspect for all three concerns, which the use-case viewpoint frames. One UML use case diagram covers all three. Its actors show the main user types. Each actor's associated use cases show the goals that user can achieve. Include and extend relationships between use cases show how the functionalities relate. The request explicitly asks for a use case diagram, and an overview level of detail fits one diagram of the system boundary. No other viewpoint frames the 'users' aspect, so a single view is enough.
